_about: Specimen-signature authorities for GP Fund (19 Oct 2026). Five departments sent the AG their officers' specimen signatures; this file is the reference copy of what each letter says, and `python3 -m api.signatories specimens` loads it into signing_authorities / signatory_specimens with the crops cut from the letters. Reference data, not code (BUILD §5). A new letter for the same post does NOT edit an entry here: it closes the old one's effective_to and adds a new one, so a claim signed in 2025 is still compared with the officer who held the post in 2025. Department aliases include the forms an OCR'd scan actually produces -- 'GAURD'/'GAURO' for GUARD are real reads off the trial corpus, not typos.
